Visitor formats definition lists with custom templates

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_definition_description(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": f'> {text}'}
        def visit_definition_term(self, ctx, text):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": f'### {text}'}
    html = "<dl><dt>Python</dt><dd>A high-level programming language</dd><dt>JavaScript</dt><dd>A scripting language for web browsers</dd></dl>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
